description: USA Short-Term Weather Warnings is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. The National Weather Service issues warnings for severe weather that are imminent or actively occurring. This layer shows shorter-term warnings for the following events: Special Marine Warnings - potentially hazardous weather conditions of short duration (up to 2 hours) that may include sustained winds or gusts of 39 mph or greater, hail 0.75” or greater ... Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Natural Hazards. Its keywords are weather, severe weather. The portal shows 2025-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ESRI Custom License (https://content.esri.com/arcgisonline/docs/tou_summary.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
